lib.label: Repo-relative directory of the Angular lib that gets the component (e.g. libs/web/catalog/ui)

name.label: Component name, dash-case (e.g. order-card); the class is OrderCard and the selector <prefix>-order-card

kind.label: container (owns data access, lives in a feature lib) or presentational (inputs and outputs only, lives in a ui lib). Omit to read it from the lib's type tag; a flag may only agree with it

inputs.label: Presentational only. Comma-separated required signal inputs as name:type, type string, number or boolean (e.g. label:string,count:number)

outputs.label: Presentational only. Comma-separated signal outputs without payload, camelCase (e.g. selected,dismissed)

folder.label: Folder under src/lib that holds the files, dash-case. Omit to use the name; set it to group related artifacts (e.g. experiments for a service and its directive)

description: New standalone Angular component in a ui or feature lib: <lib>/src/lib/<name>/<name>.ts, .html, .css and .spec.ts (no class suffix), exported from the lib barrel. Signal inputs and outputs are readonly, there is no changeDetection property (OnPush is the default in Angular 22) and no decorators besides @Component. A component in a feature lib is a container and takes no inputs or outputs; one in a ui lib is presentational. Gives the lib a unit-test target when it has none. Replaces nx g @nx/angular:component.
